    type:

Definition pair_before (p q : mf_pair) : Prop :=
  (fst p < fst q)%Z \/ (fst p = fst q /\ (snd p <= snd q)%nat).

most_frequent_spec

cjr.examples.most_frequent.most_frequent_spec

definition most_frequent_spec:
    parameter(xs, type(list(Z)))
    parameter(answer, type(option(Z)))
    type:
        Prop
    body:
        match RegularStyle:
            xs
            answer
            case:
                patterns(empty_list, None)
                true_proposition
            case:
                patterns(empty_list, Some(_))
                false_proposition
            case:
                patterns(cons(_, _), None)
                false_proposition
            case:
                patterns(cons(_, _), Some(x))
                and:
                    in_scope nat(greater_than(mf_frequency(x, xs), 0))
                    and:
                        in_scope nat:
                            forall:
                                binders:
                                    parameter(y, type(_ (inferred)))
                                less_or_equal(mf_frequency(y, xs), mf_frequency(x, xs))
                        in_scope nat:
                            forall:
                                binders:
                                    parameter(y, type(_ (inferred)))
                                arrow:
                                    equals(mf_frequency(y, xs), mf_frequency(x, xs))
                                    less_or_equal:
                                        mf_first_index_or_len(x, xs)
                                        mf_first_index_or_len(y, xs)
Original declaration (proof-free)
Definition most_frequent_spec (xs : list Z) (answer : option Z) : Prop :=
  match xs, answer with
  | [], None => True
  | [], Some _ => False
  | _ :: _, None => False
  | _ :: _, Some x =>
      (mf_frequency x xs > 0)%nat /\
      (forall y, mf_frequency y xs <= mf_frequency x xs)%nat /\
      (forall y, mf_frequency y xs = mf_frequency x xs ->
         mf_first_index_or_len x xs <= mf_first_index_or_len y xs)%nat
  end.

mf_choose

cjr.examples.most_frequent.mf_choose

recursive function mf_choose:
    parameter(xs, candidates, type(list(Z)))
    type:
        option(Z)
    body:
        match RegularStyle:
            candidates
            case:
                patterns(empty_list)
                None
            case:
                patterns(cons(x, rest))
                match RegularStyle:
                    mf_choose(xs, rest)
                    case:
                        patterns(None)
                        Some(x)
                    case:
                        patterns(Some(y))
                        if:
                            Nat.leb(mf_frequency(y, xs), mf_frequency(x, xs))
                            then:
                                Some(x)
                            else:
                                Some(y)
Original declaration (proof-free)
Fixpoint mf_choose (xs candidates : list Z) : option Z :=
  match candidates with
  | [] => None
  | x :: rest =>
      match mf_choose xs rest with
      | None => Some x
      | Some y =>
          if Nat.leb (mf_frequency y xs) (mf_frequency x xs)
          then Some x else Some y
      end
  end.

mf_choose_sound

cjr.examples.most_frequent.mf_choose_sound

lemma mf_choose_sound:
    parameter(xs, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(candidates, type(_ (inferred)))
    statement:
        match RegularStyle:
            mf_choose(xs, candidates)
            case:
                patterns(None)
                equals(candidates, empty_list)
            case:
                patterns(Some(x))
                and:
                    In(x, candidates)
                    and:
                        in_scope nat:
                            forall:
                                binders:
                                    parameter(y, type(_ (inferred)))
                                arrow:
                                    In(y, candidates)
                                    less_or_equal(mf_frequency(y, xs), mf_frequency(x, xs))
                        in_scope nat:
                            forall:
                                binders:
                                    parameter(y, type(_ (inferred)))
                                arrow:
                                    In(y, candidates)
                                    arrow:
                                        equals(mf_frequency(y, xs), mf_frequency(x, xs))
                                        less_or_equal:
                                            mf_first_index_or_len(x, candidates)
                                            mf_first_index_or_len(y, candidates)
Original declaration (proof-free)
Lemma mf_choose_sound xs candidates :
  match mf_choose xs candidates with
  | None => candidates = []
  | Some x => In x candidates /\
      (forall y, In y candidates -> mf_frequency y xs <= mf_frequency x xs)%nat /\
      (forall y, In y candidates -> mf_frequency y xs = mf_frequency x xs ->
        mf_first_index_or_len x candidates <= mf_first_index_or_len y candidates)%nat
  end.

mf_pair_leb

cjr.examples.most_frequent.mf_pair_leb

definition mf_pair_leb:
    parameter(p, q, type(mf_pair))
    type:
        bool
    body:
        if_then_else:
            Z.leb(fst(p), fst(q))
            if_then_else:
                Z.leb(fst(q), fst(p))
                Nat.leb(snd(p), snd(q))
                true
            false
Original declaration (proof-free)
Definition mf_pair_leb (p q : mf_pair) : bool :=
  if Z.leb (fst p) (fst q) then
    if Z.leb (fst q) (fst p) then Nat.leb (snd p) (snd q) else true
  else false.

Definition mf_pair_swap (xs : list mf_pair) (i j : nat) : list mf_pair :=
  match xs !! i, xs !! j with
  | Some x, Some y => <[i := y]> (<[j := x]> xs)
  | _, _ => xs
  end.

lemma mf_count_insert:
    parameter(xs, type(list(mf_pair)))

    parameter(y, type(_ (inferred)))

                                i

                            xs

                        mf_pair_eq_dec(z, y)

                        0

                        mf_pair_eq_dec(z, x)
                        1
                        0

Lemma mf_count_insert (xs : list mf_pair) i y x z :
  xs !! i = Some y ->
  count_occ (mf_pair_eq_dec) (<[i:=x]> xs) z + (if mf_pair_eq_dec z y then 1 else 0)
    = count_occ (mf_pair_eq_dec) xs z + (if mf_pair_eq_dec z x then 1 else 0).

recursive function mf_lomuto:
    parameter(fuel, type(nat))
    parameter(xs, type(list(mf_pair)))
    parameter(pivot, type(mf_pair))
    parameter(i, j, bound, type(nat))
    type:
        product_type(list(mf_pair), nat)
    body:
        match RegularStyle:
            fuel
            case:
                patterns(O)
                tuple_with_tail_items(xs, items(i))
            case:
                patterns(S(fuel))
                if_then_else:
                    Nat.ltb(j, bound)
                    match RegularStyle:
                        lookup(xs, j)
                        case:
                            patterns(Some(v))
                            if_then_else:
                                mf_pair_leb(v, pivot)
                                mf_lomuto:
                                    fuel
                                    mf_pair_swap(xs, i, j)
                                    pivot
                                    S(i)
                                    S(j)
                                    bound
                                mf_lomuto(fuel, xs, pivot, i, S(j), bound)
                        case:
                            patterns(None)
                            tuple_with_tail_items(xs, items(i))
                    tuple_with_tail_items(xs, items(i))
Original declaration (proof-free)
Fixpoint mf_lomuto (fuel : nat) (xs : list mf_pair) (pivot : mf_pair)
    (i j bound : nat) : list mf_pair * nat :=
  match fuel with
  | O => (xs, i)
  | S fuel =>
    if Nat.ltb j bound then
      match xs !! j with
      | Some v => if mf_pair_leb v pivot then
          mf_lomuto fuel (mf_pair_swap xs i j) pivot (S i) (S j) bound
        else mf_lomuto fuel xs pivot i (S j) bound
      | None => (xs, i)
      end
    else (xs, i)
  end.

Definition mf_partition (xs : list mf_pair) (lo hi : nat) : list mf_pair * nat :=
  match xs !! (hi - 1)%nat with
  | Some pivot =>
      let '(ys, p) := mf_lomuto ((hi - 1) - lo)%nat xs pivot lo lo (hi - 1)%nat in
      (mf_pair_swap ys p (hi - 1)%nat, p)
  | None => (xs, lo)
  end.

Original declaration (proof-free)
Fixpoint mf_qsort_slice (fuel : nat) (xs : list mf_pair) (lo hi : nat) : list mf_pair :=
  match fuel with
  | O => xs
  | S fuel => if Nat.leb hi (lo + 1)%nat then xs else
      let '(ys, p) := mf_partition xs lo hi in
      mf_qsort_slice fuel (mf_qsort_slice fuel ys lo p) (S p) hi
  end.

mf_run_summaries

cjr.examples.most_frequent.mf_run_summaries

recursive function mf_run_summaries:
    parameter(pairs, type(list(mf_pair)))
    type:
        list(mf_summary)
    body:
        match RegularStyle:
            pairs
            case:
                patterns(empty_list)
                empty_list
            case:
                patterns(cons(p, ps))
                match RegularStyle:
                    mf_run_summaries(ps)
                    case:
                        patterns(empty_list)
                        list(mf_single_summary(p))
                    case:
                        patterns(cons(s, rest))
                        if_then_else:
                            Z.eq_dec(fst(p), fst(s))
                            cons(mf_extend_summary(p, s), rest)
                            cons(mf_single_summary(p), cons(s, rest))
Original declaration (proof-free)
Fixpoint mf_run_summaries (pairs : list mf_pair) : list mf_summary :=
  match pairs with
  | [] => []
  | p :: ps =>
    match mf_run_summaries ps with
    | [] => [mf_single_summary p]
    | s :: rest => if Z.eq_dec (fst p) (fst s)
        then mf_extend_summary p s :: rest
        else mf_single_summary p :: s :: rest
    end
  end.

definition mf_pair_summary_valid:
    parameter(pairs, type(list(mf_pair)))
    parameter(s, type(mf_summary))
    type:
        Prop
    body:
        and:
            equals:
                mf_summary_count(s)
                mf_frequency:
                    fst(s)
                    notation "_ <$> _":
                        fst
                        pairs
            and:
                in_scope nat(less_than(0, mf_summary_count(s)))
                and:
                    In(tuple_with_tail_items(fst(s), items(mf_summary_first(s))), pairs)
                    forall:
                        binders:
                            parameter(i, type(_ (inferred)))
                        arrow:
                            In(tuple_with_tail_items(fst(s), items(i)), pairs)
                            in_scope nat(less_or_equal(mf_summary_first(s), i))
Original declaration (proof-free)
Definition mf_pair_summary_valid (pairs : list mf_pair) (s : mf_summary) : Prop :=
  mf_summary_count s = mf_frequency (fst s) (fst <$> pairs) /\
  (0 < mf_summary_count s)%nat /\
  In (fst s, mf_summary_first s) pairs /\
  (forall i, In (fst s, i) pairs -> (mf_summary_first s <= i)%nat).

mf_partition_step

cjr.examples.most_frequent.mf_partition_step

definition mf_partition_step:
    parameter(oa, ob, type(loc))
    parameter(pivot, type(mf_pair))
    parameter(li, lj, type(loc))
    type:
        expr
    body:
        let_binding:
            Some("v")
            App:
                Rec(None, Some("args"), array.get_body)
                Struct:
                    empty_list
                    list_with_tail_items(Val(LitV(LitObj(oa))), items(qsort.sload(lj)))
            let_binding:
                Some("ix")
                App:
                    Rec(None, Some("args"), array.get_body)
                    Struct:
                        empty_list
                        list_with_tail_items(Val(LitV(LitObj(ob))), items(qsort.sload(lj)))
                let_binding:
                    None
                    conditional:
                        mf_lex_compare:
                            Var("v")
                            Var("ix")
                            Val(LitV(LitInt(fst(pivot))))
                            Val(LitV(LitInt(Z.of_nat(snd(pivot)))))
                        let_binding:
                            None
                            App:
                                Rec(None, Some("args"), mf_swap_body)
                                Struct:
                                    empty_list
                                    list_with_tail_items:
                                        Val(LitV(LitObj(oa)))
                                        items:
                                            Val(LitV(LitObj(ob)))
                                            qsort.sload(li)
                                            qsort.sload(lj)
                            qsort.sset(li, qsort.plus1(qsort.sload(li)))
                        Val(LitV(LitUnit))
                    qsort.sset(lj, qsort.plus1(qsort.sload(lj)))
Original declaration (proof-free)
Definition mf_partition_step (oa ob : loc) (pivot : mf_pair) (li lj : loc) : expr :=
  Let (Some "v")
    (App (Rec None (Some "args") array.get_body)
      (Struct [] [Val (LitV (LitObj oa)); qsort.sload lj]))
    (Let (Some "ix")
      (App (Rec None (Some "args") array.get_body)
        (Struct [] [Val (LitV (LitObj ob)); qsort.sload lj]))
      (Let None
        (If (mf_lex_compare (Var "v") (Var "ix")
          (Val (LitV (LitInt (fst pivot))))
          (Val (LitV (LitInt (Z.of_nat (snd pivot))))))
          (Let None
            (App (Rec None (Some "args") mf_swap_body)
              (Struct [] [Val (LitV (LitObj oa)); Val (LitV (LitObj ob));
                qsort.sload li; qsort.sload lj]))
            (qsort.sset li (qsort.plus1 (qsort.sload li))))
          (Val (LitV LitUnit)))
        (qsort.sset lj (qsort.plus1 (qsort.sload lj))))).

mf_partition_step_wp

lemma mf_partition_step_wp:
    typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(cjrGS(Σ)))
    typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(invGS_gen(HasLc, Σ)))
    parameter(pairs, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(oa, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(ob, type(_ (inferred)))

                consuming_implies:

                    consuming_implies:

                        consuming_implies:

                                                        S(i)
                                                        i
                                            separately:
                                                owns_stack(StackId(lj), qsort.nval(S(j)))
                                                mf_pair_arrays:
                                                    if_then_else:

                                                        mf_pair_swap(pairs, i, j)
                                                        pairs
                                                    oa
                                                    ob

Lemma mf_partition_step_wp `{!cjrGS Σ} `{!invGS_gen HasLc Σ}

      StackId lj ↦ₛ qsort.nval (S j) ∗
      mf_pair_arrays (if mf_pair_leb q pivot then mf_pair_swap pairs i j else pairs) oa ob }}.

lemma mf_partition_scan_wp:
    typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(cjrGS(Σ)))
    typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(invGS_gen(HasLc, Σ)))
    parameter(n, type(_ (inferred)))

    parameter(j, type(_ (inferred)))

        arrow:
            in_scope nat(less_than(0, hi))
            arrow:
                in_scope nat(equals(subtract(subtract(hi, 1), j), n))
                arrow:
                    in_scope nat(less_or_equal(i, j))
                    arrow:
                        in_scope nat(less_or_equal(j, subtract(hi, 1)))
                        arrow:
                            in_scope nat(less_than(subtract(hi, 1), length(pairs)))

                                consuming_implies:

                                    consuming_implies:

                                            post binder(_)
                                            postcondition:
                                                exists:
                                                    binders:
                                                        parameter(ys, type(_ (inferred)))
                                                        parameter(p, type(_ (inferred)))
                                                    separately:
                                                        pure:
                                                            equals:
                                                                mf_lomuto:
                                                                    n
                                                                    pairs
                                                                    pivot
                                                                    i
                                                                    j
                                                                    in_scope nat:
                                                                        subtract(hi, 1)
                                                                tuple_with_tail_items:
                                                                    ys
                                                                    items(p)
                                                        separately:
                                                            owns_stack:
                                                                StackId(li)
                                                                qsort.nval(p)
                                                            separately:
                                                                owns_stack:
                                                                    StackId(lj)
                                                                    qsort.nval:
                                                                        subtract(hi, 1)
                                                                mf_pair_arrays(ys, oa, ob)

  StackId li ↦ₛ qsort.nval i -∗ StackId lj ↦ₛ qsort.nval j -∗
  mf_pair_arrays pairs oa ob -∗
  WP mf_partition_scan oa ob hi pivot li lj
    {{ _, ∃ ys p, ⌜mf_lomuto n pairs pivot i j (hi - 1)%nat = (ys,p)⌝ ∗
      StackId li ↦ₛ qsort.nval p ∗ StackId lj ↦ₛ qsort.nval (hi - 1) ∗
      mf_pair_arrays ys oa ob }}.

recursive function mf_scan_run:
    parameter(value, type(Z))
    parameter(first, type(nat))
    parameter(pairs, type(list(mf_pair)))
    type:
        product_type(nat, nat)
    body:
        match RegularStyle:
            pairs
            case:
                patterns(empty_list)
                tuple_with_tail_items(in_scope nat(0), items(first))
            case:
                patterns(cons(p, ps))
                if_then_else:
                    Z.eq_dec(fst(p), value)
                    match LetPatternStyle:
                        mf_scan_run(value, Nat.min(first, snd(p)), ps)
                        case:
                            patterns(tuple_with_tail_items(count, items(minimum)))
                            tuple_with_tail_items(S(count), items(minimum))
                    tuple_with_tail_items(in_scope nat(0), items(first))
Original declaration (proof-free)
Fixpoint mf_scan_run (value : Z) (first : nat) (pairs : list mf_pair) : nat * nat :=
  match pairs with
  | [] => (0%nat, first)
  | p :: ps => if Z.eq_dec (fst p) value then
      let '(count, minimum) := mf_scan_run value (Nat.min first (snd p)) ps in
      (S count, minimum)
    else (0%nat, first)
  end.

                    owns_stack(StackId(le), qsort.nval(j))
                    consuming_implies:
                        owns_stack(StackId(lf), qsort.nval(first))
                        consuming_implies:
                            mf_pair_arrays(pairs, oa, ob)
                            wp_partial:
                                mf_group_inner(oa, ob, length(pairs), value, le, lf)
                                post binder(_)
                                postcondition:
                                    separately:
                                        owns_stack:
                                            StackId(le)
                                            qsort.nval:
                                                in_scope nat:
                                                    add:
                                                        j
                                                        fst:
                                                            mf_scan_run:
                                                                value
                                                                first
                                                                suffix
                                        separately:
                                            owns_stack:
                                                StackId(lf)
                                                qsort.nval:
                                                    snd(mf_scan_run(value, first, suffix))
                                            mf_pair_arrays(pairs, oa, ob)
Original declaration (proof-free)
Lemma mf_group_inner_wp `{!cjrGS Σ} `{!invGS_gen HasLc Σ}
    suffix pairs oa ob le lf value j first :
  drop j pairs = suffix -> (j <= length pairs)%nat ->
  StackId le ↦ₛ qsort.nval j -∗ StackId lf ↦ₛ qsort.nval first -∗
  mf_pair_arrays pairs oa ob -∗
  WP mf_group_inner oa ob (length pairs) value le lf
    {{ _, StackId le ↦ₛ qsort.nval (j + fst (mf_scan_run value first suffix))%nat ∗
      StackId lf ↦ₛ qsort.nval (snd (mf_scan_run value first suffix)) ∗
      mf_pair_arrays pairs oa ob }}.

  | _ => Val (LitV LitUnit)
  end.

            runs

                list(a)

                patterns(cons(b, bs))

      then mf_merge_summary a b :: bs else a :: runs
  end.

recursive function mf_forward_scan:
    parameter(fuel, type(_ (inferred)))

        mf_summary
    body:

                    pairs
                    case:
                        patterns(empty_list)
                        best
                    case:

                                patterns(tuple_with_tail_items(extra, items(minimum)))

                                    fuel'

                                                tuple_with_tail_items:
                                                    S(extra)
                                                    items(minimum)

Fixpoint mf_forward_scan fuel (pairs : list mf_pair) best : mf_summary :=
  match fuel with
  | O => best
  | S fuel' => match pairs with
    | [] => best
    | p::ps => let '(extra,minimum) := mf_scan_run (fst p) (snd p) ps in
      mf_forward_scan fuel' (drop extra ps)
        (mf_update_best best (fst p,(S extra,minimum)))
    end
  end.

mf_group_step

cjr.examples.most_frequent.mf_group_step

definition mf_group_step:
    parameter(oa, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(ob, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(n, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(lv, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(lc, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(lf, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(lj, type(_ (inferred)))
    type:
        expr
    body:
        let_binding:
            Some("value")
            App:
                Rec(None, Some("args"), array.get_body)
                Struct:
                    empty_list
                    list_with_tail_items(Val(LitV(LitObj(oa))), items(qsort.sload(lj)))
            VarBind:
                "end"
                qsort.plus1(qsort.sload(lj))
                VarBind:
                    "first"
                    App:
                        Rec(None, Some("args"), array.get_body)
                        Struct:
                            empty_list
                            list_with_tail_items:
                                Val(LitV(LitObj(ob)))
                                items(qsort.sload(lj))
                    let_binding:
                        None
                        while_loop:
                            conditional:
                                BinOp(LeOp, qsort.plus1(Var("end")), Val(qsort.nval(n)))
                                BinOp:
                                    EqOp
                                    App:
                                        Rec(None, Some("args"), array.get_body)
                                        Struct:
                                            empty_list
                                            list_with_tail_items:
                                                Val(LitV(LitObj(oa)))
                                                items(Var("end"))
                                    Var("value")
                                Val(LitV(LitBool(false)))
                            let_binding:
                                Some("ix")
                                App:
                                    Rec(None, Some("args"), array.get_body)
                                    Struct:
                                        empty_list
                                        list_with_tail_items:
                                            Val(LitV(LitObj(ob)))
                                            items(Var("end"))
                                let_binding:
                                    None
                                    conditional:
                                        BinOp(LeOp, qsort.plus1(Var("ix")), Var("first"))
                                        Assign("first", Var("ix"))
                                        Val(LitV(LitUnit))
                                    Assign("end", qsort.plus1(Var("end")))
                        let_binding:
                            Some("count")
                            BinOp(MinusOp, Var("end"), qsort.sload(lj))
                            let_binding:
                                None
                                conditional:
                                    conditional:
                                        BinOp:
                                            LeOp
                                            qsort.plus1(qsort.sload(lc))
                                            Var("count")
                                        Val(LitV(LitBool(true)))
                                        conditional:
                                            BinOp(EqOp, qsort.sload(lc), Var("count"))
                                            BinOp:
                                                LeOp
                                                qsort.plus1(Var("first"))
                                                qsort.sload(lf)
                                            Val(LitV(LitBool(false)))
                                    let_binding:
                                        None
                                        qsort.sset(lv, Var("value"))
                                        let_binding:
                                            None
                                            qsort.sset(lc, Var("count"))
                                            qsort.sset(lf, Var("first"))
                                    Val(LitV(LitUnit))
                                qsort.sset(lj, Var("end"))
Original declaration (proof-free)
Definition mf_group_step oa ob n lv lc lf lj : expr :=
  Let (Some "value") (App (Rec None (Some "args") array.get_body)
    (Struct [] [Val (LitV (LitObj oa)); qsort.sload lj]))
  (VarBind "end" (qsort.plus1 (qsort.sload lj))
  (VarBind "first" (App (Rec None (Some "args") array.get_body)
    (Struct [] [Val (LitV (LitObj ob)); qsort.sload lj]))
  (Let None
    (While (If (BinOp LeOp (qsort.plus1 (Var "end")) (Val (qsort.nval n)))
      (BinOp EqOp (App (Rec None (Some "args") array.get_body)
        (Struct [] [Val (LitV (LitObj oa)); Var "end"])) (Var "value"))
      (Val (LitV (LitBool false))))
      (Let (Some "ix") (App (Rec None (Some "args") array.get_body)
        (Struct [] [Val (LitV (LitObj ob)); Var "end"]))
        (Let None (If (BinOp LeOp (qsort.plus1 (Var "ix")) (Var "first"))
          (Assign "first" (Var "ix")) (Val (LitV LitUnit)))
          (Assign "end" (qsort.plus1 (Var "end"))))))
    (Let (Some "count") (BinOp MinusOp (Var "end") (qsort.sload lj))
    (Let None (If
      (If (BinOp LeOp (qsort.plus1 (qsort.sload lc)) (Var "count"))
        (Val (LitV (LitBool true)))
        (If (BinOp EqOp (qsort.sload lc) (Var "count"))
          (BinOp LeOp (qsort.plus1 (Var "first")) (qsort.sload lf))
          (Val (LitV (LitBool false)))))
      (Let None (qsort.sset lv (Var "value"))
        (Let None (qsort.sset lc (Var "count")) (qsort.sset lf (Var "first"))))
      (Val (LitV LitUnit)))
      (qsort.sset lj (Var "end"))))))).

mf_group_step_wp

cjr.examples.most_frequent.mf_group_step_wp

lemma mf_group_step_wp:
    typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(cjrGS(Σ)))
    typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(invGS_gen(HasLc, Σ)))
    parameter(pairs, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(p, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(ps, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(oa, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(ob, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(lv, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(lc, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(lf, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(lj, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(j, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(best, type(_ (inferred)))
    statement:
        arrow:
            equals(drop(j, pairs), cons(p, ps))
            arrow:
                in_scope nat(less_than(j, length(pairs)))
                consuming_implies:
                    owns_stack(StackId(lj), qsort.nval(j))
                    consuming_implies:
                        mf_best_cells(best, lv, lc, lf)
                        consuming_implies:
                            mf_pair_arrays(pairs, oa, ob)
                            wp_partial:
                                mf_group_step(oa, ob, length(pairs), lv, lc, lf, lj)
                                post binder(v)
                                postcondition:
                                    separately:
                                        pure(equals(v, LitV(LitUnit)))
                                        separately:
                                            owns_stack:
                                                StackId(lj)
                                                qsort.nval:
                                                    in_scope nat:
                                                        add:
                                                            j
                                                            S:
                                                                fst:
                                                                    mf_scan_run:
                                                                        fst(p)
                                                                        snd(p)
                                                                        ps
                                            separately:
                                                mf_best_cells:
                                                    mf_update_best:
                                                        best
                                                        tuple_with_tail_items:
                                                            fst(p)
                                                            items:
                                                                tuple_with_tail_items:
                                                                    S:
                                                                        fst:
                                                                            mf_scan_run:
                                                                                fst(p)
                                                                                snd(p)
                                                                                ps
                                                                    items:
                                                                        snd:
                                                                            mf_scan_run:
                                                                                fst(p)
                                                                                snd(p)
                                                                                ps
                                                    lv
                                                    lc
                                                    lf
                                                mf_pair_arrays(pairs, oa, ob)
Original declaration (proof-free)
Lemma mf_group_step_wp `{!cjrGS Σ} `{!invGS_gen HasLc Σ}
    pairs p ps oa ob lv lc lf lj j best :
  drop j pairs = p::ps -> (j < length pairs)%nat ->
  StackId lj ↦ₛ qsort.nval j -∗ mf_best_cells best lv lc lf -∗
  mf_pair_arrays pairs oa ob -∗
  WP mf_group_step oa ob (length pairs) lv lc lf lj
    {{ v, ⌜v = LitV LitUnit⌝ ∗
      StackId lj ↦ₛ qsort.nval (j + S (fst (mf_scan_run (fst p) (snd p) ps)))%nat ∗
      mf_best_cells (mf_update_best best
        (fst p,(S (fst (mf_scan_run (fst p) (snd p) ps)),
          snd (mf_scan_run (fst p) (snd p) ps)))) lv lc lf ∗
      mf_pair_arrays pairs oa ob }}.
